cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Need Your Blessing
cards.instruction: Get approval from someone whose opinion still carries emotional weight, even when permission is unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Dad, I've accepted the museum job. Can you be pleased I'm leaving the workshop?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're thirty. You don't need me to release you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I need the person who taught me to make things to think this counts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pack your tools. You might want to come back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you sharpen them for the museum instead? Send me off expecting me to do well.
